description: Retrospective descriptive four-label comparison of historical prefix A, complete-source original B and combined NT2/IH; not a controlled truncation experiment.
source_quote_verification: Common strict analysis checks original full supplied record for every run. A-prefix quote verification is additionally reported separately because A received only the first 7000 characters.

historical_A.metric_definition: 4-class metrics on eligible matched predictions under classification policy; macro-F1 uses all study labels
historical_A.eligibility_definition: Require complete structural output, valid label and matching metadata. A quote-only recorded error does not exclude a prediction; evidence flags remain visible. Other errors remain excluded.
